headline: 穆里尼奧紀錄片、新書書評
context: Netflix 推出足球教練穆里尼奧（José Mourinho）的三集紀錄片，由曾拍過《Bros: After the Screaming Stops》的導演喬・波爾曼（Joe Pearlman）執導；劇評形容穆里尼奧全片顯得防備心重，片尾他自己也說「你在逼我談自己……而我不想。」書市方面，記者瑞秋・阿維夫（Rachel Aviv）推出新書《You Won't Get Free of It》，收錄六篇原刊於《紐約客》、探討母女關係的紀實故事，其中一篇寫到心理學家伊莉莎白・洛夫特斯（Elizabeth Loftus）——她曾為包括哈維・溫斯坦（Harvey Weinstein）在內的多起訴訟擔任專家證人。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining… Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The most complex of female relationships is thrown into sharp relief in this moving series of essays Rachel Aviv has a profound interest in the vagaries of human psychology: Strangers to Ourselves, her last book, profiled five people whose psychiatric states resisted straightforward explanation, testing the limits of the mental health system. A Pulitzer finalist, Aviv has become known for rigorous, penetrating journalism that is as empathic as it is insightful. Now comes You Won’t Get Free of It, six stories of mothers and daughters, all originally published in the New Yorker. Madness runs through this book, too, in the stories of Linda Bishop, a woman who, upon discharge from hospital after a psychotic break, holed up in an abandoned farmhouse and tried to subsist on apples alone, and of Mary, a woman whose delusions and paranoia were only seemingly cured as a side-effect of chemotherapy. It’s also there in the childhood memories of the psychologist Elizabeth Loftus – a professional court witness for those who have been accused of abuse, one of whom was Harvey Weinstein. Loftus’s mother was found drowned, perhaps as a result of suicide. In Aviv’s masterly profile, she teases out a conclusion that leaves you pondering the extent to which this memory expert can rely on her own recollections, and what that says about her particular line of work. thread_text:
Netflix 推出足球教練穆里尼奧（José Mourinho）的三集紀錄片，由曾拍過《Bros: After the Screaming Stops》的導演喬・波爾曼（Joe Pearlman）執導。

劇評形容穆里尼奧全片顯得防備心重，片尾他自己也說「你在逼我談自己……而我不想。」書市方面，記者瑞秋・阿維夫（Rachel Aviv）推出新書《You Won't Get Free of It》，收錄六篇原刊於《紐約客》、探討母女關係的紀實故事，其中一篇寫到心理學家伊莉莎白・洛夫特斯（Elizabeth Loftus）——她曾為包括哈維・溫斯坦（Harvey Weinstein）在內的多起訴訟擔任專家證人。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 11 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

Netflix 推出足球教練穆里尼奧（José Mourinho）的三集紀錄片，由曾拍過《Bros: After the Screaming Stops》的導演喬・波爾曼（Joe Pearlman）執導。劇評形容穆里尼奧全片顯得防備心重，片尾他自己也說「你在逼我談自己……而我不想。」書市方面，記者瑞秋・阿維夫（Rachel Aviv）推出新書《You Won't Get Free of It》，收錄六篇原刊於《紐約客》、探討母女關係的紀實故事，其中一篇寫到心理學家伊莉莎白・洛夫特斯（Elizabeth Loftus）——她曾為包括哈維・溫斯坦（Harvey Weinstein）在內的多起訴訟擔任專家證人。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 11 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 足球教練穆里尼奧，出了一部 Netflix 紀錄片，一共三集。劇評說，他在片中顯得防備心很重，片尾他自己也說：『你在逼我談自己……而我不想。』書市這邊，記者阿維夫出了一本新書，收錄六篇探討母女關係的紀實故事，原本都刊在《紐約客》上。其中一篇寫到心理學家洛夫特斯，她曾在多起訴訟裡擔任專家證人，包括好萊塢製片人哈維・溫斯坦的案子。
